title: Application of machine learning algorithms in osteoporosis analysis based on cardiovascular health assessed by life's essential 8: a cross-sectional study.
summary: The primary article integrates six machine-learning models with NHANES Life’s Essential 8 features to analyze osteoporosis risk and interprets the best model with SHAP.
ai_technology: Six learned models estimate osteoporosis risk from LE8 features and SHAP explains contributions.
organization: Beijing Friendship Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: The primary article integrates six machine-learning models with NHANES Life’s Essential 8 features to analyze osteoporosis risk and interprets the best model with SHAP.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: Six learned models estimate osteoporosis risk from LE8 features and SHAP explains contributions.
